notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least four +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
Cast Eternal Scourge either from your hand or from exile by paying {0}.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Eternal Scourge enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Wandering Archaic from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Wandering Archaic by paying {0}.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Wandering Archaic enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Eternal Scourge from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
